body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and it burns 1 die if it willingly moves more than 2 units before its next turn ends.

surges.html: On a success, the target's equipment-granted Defense is reduced by 1 until the start of its next turn.
Ignore 1 Defense granted by equipment or cover for this Action.

rider.title: SUPPRESSION
rider.html: If your Locked target is affected, increase the first die it burns because of this Action by 1.
